info.title: billparse
info.description:
HTTP API: upload a file, get the parsed document; read and manage the layout specs and the learning jobs.

    uvicorn billparse.api:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000        (the API page: GET /parse)
    curl -F file=@invoice.pdf localhost:8000/parse

The paths and response models are invoice-parser's (invoiceparse/api.py and webapi.py), so its web app and clients
work unchanged. The store comes from the environment (DATABASE_URL, PARSER_DATA_DIR), as for the CLI. Parsing runs
billparse's pipeline: built-in specs, learned specs, the rule mapper, then (with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) the LLM routes.

Parses run in worker processes (python -m billparse worker), never in the API: POST /parse/jobs queues one and answers
at once (poll GET /parse/jobs/{id}, or give a callback_url for a signed webhook). POST /parse queues one and waits for
it, up to PARSE_WAIT_SECONDS (300): a parse that takes longer answers 202 with the job, as POST /parse/jobs does.
With AGENT_ENABLED=1, a file that no spec proves gets one from the agent in a learning job of its own (agent.py): the
parse answers with its first-pass result, and a proved spec replaces the stored result later (the webhook event
result.updated). /learn/jobs lists every learning run. Learning costs money: it is off unless AGENT_ENABLED=1.

post.description: Admit the signed-in person with an invite code (once: later sign-ins need no code).
Queue a parse of a file and return at once; GET /parse/tasks/{sha256} says how it goes.

post.description:
Parse the stored file again and run the agent for it again (a new spec, or an improve round on the spec that
reads it), in the background. Paid when learning is on.

Price the stored result again with the current price catalog, in the background: the stored rows are priced
again, never the file parsed again (free, no model request). body: new defaults (else the earlier ones).

request, so it is free.

get.description: Parse and reprice jobs, newest first.

schema.title: Response Parse Jobs Parse Jobs Get

post.description:
A queued job ends `stopped` at once; a running one at the parse's next step (between two chunks of a large
file).

Parse one file (CSV, TSV, xlsx, JSON, YAML, Terraform, PDF, pptx, docx, text, zip): a worker parses it while
this request waits, up to PARSE_WAIT_SECONDS (300). Longer (a large export): 202 with the job, to poll at
GET /parse/jobs/{id}. The result is the first pass: a learning run, when the file needs one, runs after it.
The wait holds no request thread (async): many callers waiting never block the other endpoints.

schema.title: Response Get Spec Specs  Spec Id  Get

put.description: Create a spec, or save a new version of it. A spec without a status is saved as a draft.

schema.title: Response Put Spec Specs  Spec Id  Put
Response Spec History Specs  Spec Id  History Get
Response Set Spec Status Specs  Spec Id  Status Patch

post.description: Run the strict verifier: may this spec read this file? (Models off; nothing is saved.)

schema.title: Response Verify Spec Specs Verify Post

post.description:
Ask the agent for a spec for this file; save it as a draft when the code's checks prove it. Calls the Claude
API: allowed only with AGENT_ENABLED=1. A file that a saved spec already reads is refused (409, no model call)
unless `replace` is true. The new spec never overwrites a saved one: an id that exists gets a suffix.

schema.title: Response Learn Spec Specs Learn Post

get.description: Every learning run: one per layout that no spec read (status, spec made, its status, cost).

schema.title: Response Learn Jobs Learn Jobs Get

get.description: One learning run, with the code's report on the spec the agent wrote.

schema.title: Response Learn Job Learn Jobs  Job Id  Get

post.description: Run this layout's learning again: a learn job (a worker runs it when the agent is on).

schema.title: Response Learn Retry Learn Jobs  Job Id  Retry Post

post.description:
Stop a running job: it ends at its next step as failed, with what it cost so far, and the file keeps the
result it had before the run.

schema.title: Response Learn Stop Learn Jobs  Job Id  Stop Post

post.description:
Queue a parse of every stored document that no spec proved, so each layout gets a spec (in learn jobs). Calls
the Claude API once per new layout: allowed only with AGENT_ENABLED=1.

schema.title: Response Learn Backfill Learn Backfill Post

post.description: Queue the nightly loop (a worker runs it); its report is the job's result (GET /jobs/{id}).

get.description: Each schedule (the weekly AWS price refresh, the nightly loop): its next run and its last job.

schema.title: Response Job Stats Jobs Stats Get

get.description: Any job (a parse, reprice, learning run, price refresh or nightly loop), with its result.

schema.title: Response Job Get Jobs  Job Id  Get

JobOut.title: JobOut

LearningOut.description: The learning run a parse queued (a learn job): the parse's first-pass result is ready before it ends.

PriceDefaultsIn.title: PriceDefaultsIn
PriceDefaultsIn.description: What pricing may assume for lines that do not say it (each recorded in price_assumptions); empty: nothing.

Pricing.title: Pricing
Pricing.description: How the usage lines matched the public list prices (pricing.py).

PricingDefault.title: PricingDefault
PricingDefault.description:
A value the lines did not print, assumed to price them: from the request, the file's own most common value, or
the default setting.

ReviewEdits.title: ReviewEdits
ReviewEdits.description:
A person's changes to one document, sent whole each time (the server keeps no review session):
`rows` edits charges by id (any of description, cost, kind, counted, service, service_code, delete),
`added` are new charges, `dropped_gaps` the indexes of gaps marked resolved (of the stored document).
